MinSlide

c. 2013 · Web experiments

An early image slider I wrote in JavaScript.

Dates & sources

Surviving source files carry October 2013 timestamps; the original launch date is not established.

Open the demo ↗Source ↗

I made MinSlide to move between images, with slide controls and autoplay. The controls work again, but the original hosted photos are gone. The restored demo uses labeled solid-color slides in their place.
